_README: Copy to signer.config.json NEXT TO signer.cjs. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored. Every path is absolute. Keep this file, signer.cjs, its node_modules, the allowlist, the send-lock and the log OUTSIDE the project folder (the signer refuses to start otherwise). There is no key for an amount, a count, a rate or an expiry: the signer limits scope, never value.
_chainId: Must be 10 (Optimism). Any other value is a config error, not a signer for that chain.
_rpcUrl: The one RPC endpoint, pinned here and nowhere else (no argument, flag or environment variable can change it). https only, except a loopback host. It must answer eth_chainId = 0xa and should support eth_simulateV1 (simulate falls back to eth_call without it).
_signerAddress: Who signs, pays gas and (a local EOA) holds every balance. Must equal the address of the keystore below, and the 'holder' recorded in the allowlist file.
_owner: The human's own address. The ONLY destination the supervised entry points (sweep-token, sweep-eth, clear-nonce) can ever send to; none of them takes a destination argument. Must differ from signerAddress.
_projectRoot: The folder Claude Code runs in (it holds ./run/). Used only to prove that the signer, its config, the allowlist, the lock, the log and the key material sit outside it.
_keystorePath: Encrypted JSON keystore (ethers / Web3 Secret Storage v3). Decrypted only inside the signing process, only after the policy and chain checks passed. The signer has no export command.
_signerMode: How the keystore password is obtained, inside the signing process only: dpapi (Windows: a DPAPI CurrentUser blob at unlockPath, the layout tools/wallet.cjs uses) | password-file (unlockPath holds the password; file permissions are the only protection) | keychain (macOS: security find-generic-password -s unlockService [-a unlockAccount] -w) | secret-service (Linux: secret-tool lookup service unlockService).
_unlockPath: Needed for dpapi and password-file. For keychain and secret-service replace it with "unlockService": "<service name>" (and, for keychain, optionally "unlockAccount").
_allowlistPath: The policy file. Built by `node signer.cjs allowlist-init` (operator-run), never by the agent.
_allowlistSha256: The sha256 of the allowlist file, as printed by allowlist-init (sha256sum / certutil -hashfile give the same value). The signer refuses to check, simulate or sign if the file hashes to anything else.
_sendLockPath: The send-lock: taken by every send, declared in every send's output, left behind by a send that could not confirm, cleared only by `node signer.cjs reconcile`. Put this path in the wake wrappers' <signer send-lock> placeholder (I-setup.md I.2 section 7).
_logPath: Append-only JSON-lines log: broadcast-intent (hash and nonce, written BEFORE the send), broadcast-accepted, confirmed or reverted, receipt-timeout. Never key material, never signed bytes.
_tuning: Optional (defaults shown). Reads are retried with exponential back-off on HTTP 429 and 5xx; eth_sendRawTransaction is attempted exactly once, always.
